tools.name: salesflare_get_me
tools.description: Get the Salesflare user behind this API key, with team details. Use it to confirm which account the key belongs to. Salesflare API: GET /me.

tools.name: salesflare_list_users
tools.description: List the users in the team, with their ids (needed for owner and assignee fields). Salesflare API: GET /users.

tools.name: salesflare_list_groups
tools.description: List the user groups of the team. Salesflare API: GET /groups.

tools.name: salesflare_list_pipelines
tools.description: List the sales pipelines with their currency and stages. Use the ids with salesflare_list_stages and salesflare_list_opportunities. Salesflare API: GET /pipelines.

tools.name: salesflare_list_stages
tools.description: List the pipeline stages, optionally for one pipeline. Stage ids are used by salesflare_create_opportunity and salesflare_update_opportunity. Salesflare API: GET /stages.

tools.name: salesflare_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags used on accounts, contacts and opportunities. Salesflare API: GET /tags.

tools.name: salesflare_list_accounts
tools.description: List companies (accounts) in the CRM. Filter by name, domain, tag or city; use search for free text. Salesflare API: GET /accounts.

tools.name: salesflare_get_account
tools.description: Get one account by id, with its address, owner and tags. Salesflare API: GET /accounts/{account_id}.

tools.name: salesflare_list_contacts
tools.description: List people (contacts) in the CRM. Filter by email, name, account or tag; use search for free text. Salesflare API: GET /contacts.

tools.name: salesflare_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with email, phone numbers, account and owner. Salesflare API: GET /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: salesflare_list_opportunities
tools.description: List deals (opportunities) with stage, value, owner and close date. Filter by pipeline, stage, owner, account or closed state. Salesflare API: GET /opportunities.

tools.name: salesflare_get_opportunity
tools.description: Get one opportunity by id, with its stage, value, owner, account and close date. Salesflare API: GET /opportunities/{id}.

tools.name: salesflare_list_tasks
tools.description: List follow-up tasks, optionally for one account or matching a search. Salesflare API: GET /tasks.

tools.name: salesflare_create_account
tools.description: Create a company (account) in the CRM. Writes a new record. Salesflare API: POST /accounts.

tools.name: salesflare_update_account
tools.description: Change fields of one account. Only the fields you pass are sent. Writes to the CRM. Salesflare API: PUT /accounts/{account_id}.

tools.name: salesflare_create_contact
tools.description: Create a person (contact) in the CRM, optionally linked to an account. Writes a new record. Salesflare API: POST /contacts.

tools.name: salesflare_update_contact
tools.description: Change fields of one contact. Only the fields you pass are sent. Writes to the CRM. Salesflare API: PUT /contacts/{contact_id}.

tools.name: salesflare_create_opportunity
tools.description: Create a deal (opportunity) for an account, in a pipeline stage. Writes a new record. Salesflare API: POST /opportunities.

tools.name: salesflare_update_opportunity
tools.description: Change fields of one deal, for example its stage, value, owner or closed state. Only the fields you pass are sent. Writes to the CRM. Salesflare API: PUT /opportunities/{id}.

tools.name: salesflare_create_task
tools.description: Create a follow-up task, optionally linked to an account and assigned to users. Writes a new record. Salesflare API: POST /tasks.

tools.name: salesflare_update_task
tools.description: Change a task, for example mark it completed or move its reminder date. Only the fields you pass are sent. Writes to the CRM. Salesflare API: PUT /tasks/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: salesflare_list_contacts, salesflare_get_contact · Private data: salesflare_get_me, salesflare_list_tags, salesflare_list_contacts, salesflare_get_contact, salesflare_create_account, salesflare_create_contact, salesflare_update_contact, salesflare_create_opportunity, salesflare_create_task · Public sink: salesflare_list_contacts, salesflare_get_contact, salesflare_create_account, salesflare_create_contact, salesflare_create_opportunity, salesflare_create_task.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: salesflare_list_contacts, salesflare_get_contact · Private data: salesflare_get_me, salesflare_list_tags, salesflare_list_contacts, salesflare_get_contact, salesflare_create_account, salesflare_create_contact, salesflare_update_contact, salesflare_create_opportunity, salesflare_create_task · Public sink: salesflare_list_contacts, salesflare_get_contact, salesflare_create_account, salesflare_create_contact, salesflare_create_opportunity, salesflare_create_task

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
